step1_analysis.circuit_type: Charge Pump / Current Mirror Bias Network
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a current mirror and bias network, likely part of a charge pump in a fractional-N frequency synthesizer. It uses PMOS and NMOS current mirrors to supply (UP) and sink (DOWN) current to/from the output node.

paper_reference.title: A Multiband Fractional-N Frequency Synthesizer for a MIMO WLAN Transceiver RFIC

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the bias network.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. Assuming 5 active branches biased at 50uA each, I_total = 250uA. P = 1.8V * 250uA = 450uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the applied 50uA bias currents in the testbench and a 1.8V supply.

output_impedance.description: Small-signal output impedance at the output node (N9).

sky130_expected.calculation: Rout = ro_pmos || ro_nmos. ro ~ 1 / (lambda * Id). With lambda=0.1 and Id=50uA, ro = 200kOhm. Rout = 100kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the channel length modulation (lambda) of the SKY130 transistors at L=0.5um.

current_mirror_bandwidth.description: The -3dB bandwidth of the current mirror from input to output.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB ~ gm / (2 * pi * Cgs). gm ~ 2*Id/Vov = 2*50u/0.2 = 500uS. Cgs ~ 2/3 * W * L * Cox = 2/3 * 5u * 0.5u * 5fF/um2 ~ 8fF. f_3dB ~ 10 GHz. Parasitics will lower this.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated using standard square-law model and SKY130 parasitic capacitances.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise of the overall synthesizer.

sky130_expected.reasoning: System-level metric reported in the paper, depends on VCO and loop filter.
System-level metric reported in the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, output impedance, and AC current mirror bandwidth of the charge pump bias network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Charge Pump Bias Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V0 LABEL_NET_0 0 1.8
V1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8
V2 LABEL_NET_2 0 1.8
V3 LABEL_NET_3 0 1.8
V6 LABEL_NET_6 0 1.8

XM1 N3 N3 LABEL_NET_0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N1 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N8 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N2 LABEL_NET_2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N9 N1 LABEL_NET_3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N9 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N8 N7 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N7 N7 LABEL_NET_6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Bias sources
I1 N1 0 DC 50u AC 1
I3 N3 0 DC 50u
I8 VDD N8 DC 50u
I7 N7 0 DC 10u
I2 N2 0 DC 10u

* Output voltage source to measure current
VOUT N9 0 DC 0.9

.control
* 1. Operating Point for Power
op
let total_current = -i(VVDD) - i(V0) - i(V1) - i(V2) - i(V3) - i(V6)
let power = total_current * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis for Bandwidth
ac dec 20 1k 100G
let gain_mag = 20*log10(mag(i(VOUT)))
meas ac bw_3db when gain_mag=-3 fall=1
print bw_3db

* 3. DC Sweep for Output Impedance
dc VOUT 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc i1 find i(VOUT) at=0.89
meas dc i2 find i(VOUT) at=0.91
let rout = -0.02 / (i2 - i1)
print rout

quit
.endc
